response.sql: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_average FROM account_orders), regional_differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference_from_overall_average, AVG(difference_from_overall_average) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_average_difference FROM differences) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference_from_overall_average, difference_from_overall_average - region_average_difference AS excess_over_region_average FROM regional_differences WHERE difference_from_overall_average > region_average_difference ORDER BY excess_over_region_average DESC LIMIT 10;
